How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SVNIT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SVNIT Assistant Registrar position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the SVNIT Assistant Registrar recruitment is 05 October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade from a recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Registrar post is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Registrar position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in Pay Level 10, which ranges from Rs. 15600 to Rs. 39100 per month, along with a Grade Pay of Rs. 5400.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Assistant Registrar post at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the SVNIT Assistant Registrar recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Screening Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for SVNIT Assistant Registrar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. Can departmental candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, departmental candidates are eligible to apply and may receive age relaxation up to five years.

faq.question: Q10. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the SVNIT Assistant Registrar position must be submitted through the online mode only.
